contracts.name: Grandma's Photo Archive
contracts.description: A memory card died and took forty years of family photos with it. The client sent a disk image. Put the surviving fragments back in order and prove the result is intact.

stages.title: Reassemble the fragments
stages.instruction: Fragments were recovered out of order. Click them from the lowest offset to the highest.

stages.title: Verify the checksum
stages.instruction: Find the recovered file whose checksum is identical to the original.

contracts.name: The Locked Diary
contracts.description: The client found their own childhood diary, written in a secret code they no longer remember. It is a simple letter shift. Find it.

stages.title: First page
stages.instruction: Every letter was shifted by the same amount. Change the shift until the text reads as plain English, then submit.

stages.title: Last page
stages.instruction: This page uses a different shift. Decode it the same way.

contracts.name: Checkout Crash
contracts.description: An online bookshop loses orders at checkout. They sent the code from their test server. Find the lines that are wrong.

stages.title: Find the bug
stages.instruction: One line in this function is broken. Select it and submit.

stages.title: Review the fix branch
stages.instruction: The rushed fix introduced new problems. Select every faulty line.

contracts.name: Corner Cafe Audit
contracts.description: A cafe wants to know if its back-office setup is safe before it starts taking card payments. They exported their settings for you to review.

stages.title: Review the settings
stages.instruction: Select every setting that is a security problem.

stages.title: Review the firewall
stages.instruction: One firewall rule should not be there. Select it.

contracts.name: Who Printed 900 Pages?
contracts.description: Something strange happened on a dental practice's network over the weekend. They sent the exported logs. Work out what happened and in what order.

stages.title: Rebuild the timeline
stages.instruction: The log entries are shuffled. Click them from the earliest to the latest.

stages.title: Find the odd entry
stages.instruction: One entry in the access log does not belong to a normal working day. Select it.

contracts.name: The Laptop That Runs Hot
contracts.description: A laptop's fan never stops. The owner sent a snapshot of what is running, taken inside a sandbox. Find what should not be there.

stages.title: Inspect the processes
stages.instruction: Select every process that looks malicious. Check names, locations and resource use.

stages.title: Match the signature
stages.instruction: Find the sample whose signature is identical to the known one.

contracts.name: Why Is the Office So Slow?
contracts.description: An accounting office says the network crawls every afternoon. They recorded the traffic on their own network and sent it to you.

stages.title: Read the capture
stages.instruction: Select every connection that should not be happening on an office network.

stages.title: Reorder the stream
stages.instruction: These packets arrived out of order. Click them from the lowest sequence number to the highest.

contracts.name: Dead Drop
contracts.description: An anonymous board member runs a city-wide puzzle hunt and is stuck on a rival team's clues. The pay is good and nobody asks who wrote them. Underground work raises your heat.

stages.title: First clue
stages.instruction: Find the letter shift that turns this into plain English, then submit.

stages.title: Verify the token
stages.instruction: Only one of these tokens is identical to the one on the clue card.

stages.title: Final clue
stages.instruction: A different shift this time.

contracts.name: The Startup's Lost Database
contracts.description: A two-person startup lost its only database to a failed disk. They sent an image of what is left. Rebuild it before their investor demo.

stages.title: Order the pages
stages.instruction: Click the database pages from the lowest offset to the highest.

stages.title: Verify two checksums
stages.instruction: For each round, find the checksum identical to the original.

stages.title: Order the journal
stages.instruction: Now the journal fragments, lowest offset first.

contracts.name: Clinic Compliance Review
contracts.description: A clinic must pass a security review before it can store patient records. They gave you a copy of their configuration, firewall and a day of logs.

stages.title: Configuration
stages.instruction: Select every setting that is a security problem.

stages.title: Firewall
stages.instruction: Select every rule that should not be there.

stages.title: Access log
stages.instruction: Select every entry that is not normal working-day activity.

contracts.name: Ransomware Fire Drill
contracts.description: A logistics firm ran a ransomware exercise in an isolated lab and wants an outside report on what the sample did and how to recognise it.

stages.title: Reconstruct the attack
stages.instruction: Click the events from the earliest to the latest.

stages.title: Inspect the processes
stages.instruction: Select every process that looks malicious.

stages.title: Match two signatures
stages.instruction: For each round, find the sample identical to the known signature.

contracts.name: Capture Review, No Questions
contracts.description: Someone on the board has a traffic recording from a training range and wants a second opinion without their name on it. Underground work raises your heat.

stages.title: Read the capture
stages.instruction: Select every connection that should not be there.

stages.title: Reorder the stream
stages.instruction: Click the packets from the lowest sequence number to the highest.

stages.title: Decode the note
stages.instruction: A note was hidden in the stream. Find the letter shift.

contracts.name: Legacy Payroll
contracts.description: A foundry's payroll program was written by someone who retired fifteen years ago. It pays people the wrong amounts. They sent a copy of the code.

stages.title: Module one
stages.instruction: Select every faulty line.

stages.title: Module two
stages.instruction: Select every faulty line.

stages.title: Verify the build
stages.instruction: Find the build whose checksum is identical to the approved one.

contracts.name: Breach Tabletop Exercise
contracts.description: A financial firm stages a full breach exercise on its training range and hires you to investigate it as if it were real. Everything you need is in the evidence pack.

stages.title: Rebuild the timeline
stages.instruction: Click the events from the earliest to the latest.

stages.title: Access log
stages.instruction: Select every entry that is not normal working-day activity.

stages.title: Network capture
stages.instruction: Select every connection that should not be there.

stages.title: The intruder's note
stages.instruction: Find the letter shift.
